applies_why: The judge text resolves a chain-against-chain collision between the challenger's seed/loins chain and the defender's chain, so K-C governs how those chains are weighed.
quote: the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter; the defender's chain is footed but rests on the woman-route inference.
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: The phrase 'never verse by verse': I weighed whether 'does not name Joseph as the begetter' is a permissible footing/support critique or a forbidden explicit-statement test; read as faulting a footed chain for not naming Joseph, it is the latter.
why: The judge calls the challenger's chain footed yet treats its failure to name Joseph as a reason for UNDERDETERMINED, which is a verse-by-verse stating test forbidden in a chain-against-chain collision.
